name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: Shows where the current page sits in the site hierarchy.

classes.name: breadcrumb
classes.description: A wrapping row of links and separators, usually a <nav>.

attributes.name: aria-current="page"
attributes.description: Marks the current page for assistive technology.

notes: Any element can be the separator. Icons such as icon--chevron-right work well.

examples.title: With a dropdown
examples.description: Combine with the dropdown component to show hidden levels.
